newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-SCHUMKEL SCORES TWICE AS TONGA WIN 27-10.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SCHUMKEL SCORES TWICE AS TONGA WIN 27-10.

text.p: Centre Chris Schumkel raced in sparkling tries either side of the break as Tonga beat South African provincial side Border 27-10 on Wednesday.
The Tongans drove Border back with thumping tackles, but the hosts had as much themselves to blame with a mistake ridden display.
Border's best spell came midway through the second period when sustained territorial advantage resulted in Zimbabwe winger David Maidza crossing for their solitary try.
Tonga lost their opening tour match against North West 46-6, but bounced back to beat an Eastern Province invitation side 34-19 on Sunday.
They meet South Africa in a one-off test in Cape Town on June 10.

Border: Richard Bennett; David Maidza (Wayne Weyer 76 min), Greg Hechter (Mick Fritz 74 min), Andre Claasen, Kelly Hilton-Green; Greg Miller, John Bradbrook; Andre Fox, Marius Swart, Anton Botha, Johan Gehring (Lyle Blakeway 57 min), Streicher Botha, De la Rey du Preez, Ruhan van Zyl (captain) (Rod Botha 59 min), Heinrich Kok (Lionel de Ponselle 40 min).

Tonga: Gustavo Tonga; Sione Moalatu (Tevita 'Alatini 18 min), Viliami Uhi, Chris Schumkel (Talanoa Tohi 70 min), Semisi Faka'osifolau; Siua Taumalolo, Manu Vunipola; Kilioni Tu'ipulotu, Maama Molitika, Loni Katoa, Kuli Faletau, 'Alipate Ta'ufo'ou, Heaani Lavaka, Tau'lupe Siale, Ngaslu Tau.
